subject.title: [Feature]: CLI command to list pending exec approval requests

question: Should this issue's first CLI surface be read-only pending/list output only, or should it also include resolve/respond and watch behavior from the active related PR?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but exposing pending command text and especially resolving approvals from CLI changes an operator security surface that needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Ship read-only list/json first
options.body: Expose `openclaw approvals pending` through the existing `exec.approval.list` RPC, then handle resolve/respond and watch in separate security-scoped follow-up review.

options.title: Adopt broader CLI control
options.body: Use the active PR direction and require authority-path, security, CI, and live proof coverage for both listing and resolving pending approvals before merge.

options.title: Defer CLI exposure
options.body: Keep pending approval inspection in current UI/backend paths until maintainers decide the CLI contract is worth the added operator surface.

recommendation.title: Ship read-only list/json first
recommendation.body: Expose `openclaw approvals pending` through the existing `exec.approval.list` RPC, then handle resolve/respond and watch in separate security-scoped follow-up review.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the approvals CLI/docs surface and already provided concrete scoping guidance on this issue.
